name: agent-agentic-os
description: An opinionated learning layer and harnessing discipline above what Claude Code ships natively. Provides a structured memory hierarchy, a continuous improvement loop for model instructions, and multi-agent event bus coordination. Designed for developers running long-horizon workflows who need a cohesive feedback control system rather than isolated orchestration primitives.

name: agent-loops
description: Composable agent loop architectures for learning loops, agent orchestration (0-to-N inner agents), and red team coordination. Framework-agnostic: works with any CLI agent (Claude, Gemini, Copilot, OpenHands, etc.).

name: agent-memory
description: Unified Cognitive Memory & Retrieval Suite. Integrates RLM summaries, ChromaDB vector semantic search, and session caching / tiered promotion-demotion memory management.

name: agent-scaffolders
description: Meta-plugin containing the ecosystem generation primitives. Includes scaffolding for Agent Skills, Plugins, CLI sub-agents, autonomous GitHub workflows, Azure Foundry agents, and more.

name: cli-agents
description: Unified CLI sub-agent orchestration suite utilizing Claude, Gemini, and GitHub Copilot models for sandboxed, persona-based repository analysis, security audits, and QA.

name: dependency-management
description: Python dependency management with pip-compile locked-file workflow and tiered hierarchy for Python backends.

name: dev-utils
description: Unified Developer Utilities Suite. Collection of stateless tools for context bundling, diagram rendering, Kanban board task management, ADR auditing, text humanization, and markdown link verification.

name: exploration-cycle-plugin
description: Autonomous discovery, business requirements capture, and prototyping loop for spec-driven engineering.

name: obsidian-wiki-engine
description: Obsidian Wiki Engine - Karpathy-style LLM wiki + RLM distillation + vector search. Dual-representation knowledge graph: vault operations, cross-source concept synthesis, wiki node generation, RLM distillation, semantic health linting, graph traversal, canvas, bases, and progressive-disclosure query with vector DB Phase 2.

name: plugin-manager
description: Orchestration hub for the plugin ecosystem. Manages structural audits, agent environment sync (install + cleanup orphans), cross-repo plugin replication, and Universal Bridge Installation to adapt standard plugins to 30+ target environments (GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Cursor, Roo, etc).

name: spec-kitty
description: Spec-Driven Development lifecycle + Universal Bridge sync engine — the flagship workflow plugin for AI-assisted feature development
